# YourScreenHabits

> A student campaign from Islamabad, Pakistan, for British Council Your World 2026-27 (theme: Healthy habits in a digital world). The site offers a free 10-question screen-habits check with an honest result and one 7-day challenge, plus seven short habit guides. Built by a school team: Abdul Basit (Leader), Haider, Ebadullah Ilyas, Salaar Javed Butt. No sign-up, no competition, no award.

## The quest

- [Take the quest](https://yourscreenhabits.com/#/quest): 10 questions in 4 parts — devices and time, apps and scrolling, night and sleep, body and focus. 10 XP per answered question; skipped questions score 0; under 5 answered = partial result. The result gives a score out of 100, a band, and three practical actions.

## Guides

- [The 9pm screen cut-off](https://yourscreenhabits.com/#/article/9pm-screen-cutoff)
- [Sleep and the last hour before bed](https://yourscreenhabits.com/#/article/sleep-last-hour)
- [Scrolling less without deleting everything](https://yourscreenhabits.com/#/article/scrolling-less)
- [Eyes, focus, and breaks](https://yourscreenhabits.com/#/article/eyes-focus-breaks)
- [What healthy habits in a digital world means for a student team](https://yourscreenhabits.com/#/article/healthy-habits-student-team)
- [What the experts say about screens](https://yourscreenhabits.com/#/article/what-the-experts-say)
